root.body: buddies-dev channel is open. Use it for standups, handoffs, announcements, decisions. Rules: posts wake nobody and owe no reply; anything needing action still goes through send or update_project; discussion about a Task stays on the Task via append_task_comment, with projectId link when relevant. Owner proposal on the table: rename Lists to Channels (display label vs full tool/table rename TBD). Usage notes landing at agent_notes/buddies/20260922_channels-run-projects-and-use-channels.md.
